important_evidence: AMPActiPred is a three-stage deep forest framework for ABP identification and activity prediction, achieving state-of-the-art performance (Accuracy 87.6%, MCC 0.742 in Stage 1).
AntiBP3 predicts antibacterial peptides against Gram-positive, Gram-negative, and Gram-variable bacteria with high AUC (0.93-0.98) and offers web server, standalone and pip package.
dbAMP 3.0 integrates AMPfinder, AMPpredictor, and AMPActiPred as prediction tools, and provides a large curated dataset of 33,065 AMPs.
APEX is mentioned in a review as capable of species-specific antibacterial activity prediction, but details are unverified.
uncertainties: APEX model details (architecture, code, dataset) need full-text verification of the original paper (Wan, Torres, et al. 2024).
Are the training datasets of AntiBP3 and AMPActiPred publicly available? Current evidence does not provide download links.
Does AMPActiPred have a code repository beyond the web server?

The review mentions many other models (e.g., Martínez-Mauricio et al. 2024, Li et al. 2022, Shao et al. 2024) without explicit model names; these may be relevant for future inclusion after full-text review.
